tabs.title: Company Overview
tabs.content:
**Thalvox Health** operates a telehealth platform connecting patients with primary-care clinicians over video and phone visits. Clinicians currently type their own visit notes after each call, and patient-facing after-visit summaries are written in English only.

**Current Environment:**
- Video and audio visits run through a WebRTC-based calling stack that can stream audio to backend services in real time.
- An Azure AI Foundry project (`thalvox-visit-foundry`) hosts the platform's generative and speech capabilities.
- After-visit summaries and patient chat messages are stored in a clinical data store for the care team to review.
- A meaningful share of patients primarily read and write in Spanish or Vietnamese, but clinicians write only in English.

tabs.title: Requirements
tabs.content:
**Speech Requirements:**
- Clinician-patient audio must be transcribed to text in near real time so a drafting agent can prepare a visit note for the clinician to review and sign.
- The transcription must correctly recognize the clinic's own drug and procedure terminology, which is frequently misrecognized by general-purpose speech models.

**Text Analysis Requirements:**
- Patient chat messages must be automatically screened for sentiment, urgency, and mentions of self-harm or other safety-critical content so at-risk messages are escalated immediately.
- After-visit summaries must be reliably translated into the patient's preferred written language before being sent.

**Agent Requirements:**
- A scheduling agent must be reachable by voice so patients who call in can book, reschedule, or cancel visits without speaking to a human scheduler.
